Class QuicTlsUtils

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.netty.QuicTlsUtils
@Internal public final class QuicTlsUtils extends Object
TLS utilities for HTTP/3. Kept apart from NettyTlsUtils because the QUIC classes are an optional dependency.
Since:
5.3.0

      public static @Nullable List<String> keyExchangeGroups(SslConfiguration ssl)
      Resolve the configured TLS key exchange groups for HTTP/3 and check that the QUIC TLS implementation supports them.
      Parameters:
      ssl - The SSL configuration
      Returns:
      The groups to apply, or null to keep the defaults
      Throws:
      SslConfigurationException - If the groups are invalid or unsupported
